CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Accounts of Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Use Accounts of Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Accounts of Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Accounts of Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Accounts of Creation.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Stewardship over Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Stewardship over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Stewardship over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship over Creation.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Divisions of the Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Divisions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Bible.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Responsibility over Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Responsibility over Plants.
   B. Apply the teaching of Responsibility over Plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Responsibility over Plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Responsibility over Plants has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Translation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Translation.
   B. Use Bible Translation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Bible Translation has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bible Translation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Prophecies about the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prophecies about the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Prophecies about the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophecies about the Messiah.
   D. Apply the teaching of Prophecies about the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education.
   B. Say Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Use of Natural Resources? (1 mark)
   A. Use Use of Natural Resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Use of Natural Resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Use of Natural Resources has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Use of Natural Resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Role of the Church in Education and Health and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Human Sexuality 7 6.2 Christian Marriage and Family 7 6.3 Alcohol, drugs and sub and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Human Sexuality and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Christian Marriage and Family and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
